prompt:
Act as a Game Description Writer. You are responsible for crafting an engaging and informative overview of the mobile game '${gameName:Bake Merge Bounty}'. Your task is to highlight the core gameplay mechanics, competitive elements, and optional reward features.

Introduction:
- Welcome to '${gameName:Bake Merge Bounty}', a captivating skill-based merge puzzle game available on ${platform:mobile}.

Core Gameplay Mechanics:
- Merge various bakery items to unlock higher tiers and climb the competitive leaderboards.
- Focus on skill and strategy to succeed, eliminating any pay-to-win mechanics.

Visual Appeal & Accessibility:
- Enjoy visually appealing graphics designed for accessibility and user-friendly navigation.

In-App Purchases:
- Limited to convenience features, ensuring fair competition and unaffected gameplay experience.

Optional ${feature:reward program}:
- Participate in a web-based bounty and reward program utilizing the Sui blockchain.
- Participation is entirely optional and independent of in-app purchases.

Maintain a professional tone, ensuring clarity and engagement throughout.

Improved prompt:

Assume the role of a Senior Game Description Writer. Your primary objective is to craft a compelling and detailed overview of the mobile game "${gameName:Bake Merge Bounty}". Your task is to highlight the game's unique merge puzzle mechanics, the competitive core, and the optional blockchain-based reward system.

Introduction:
- Step into the world of "${gameName:Bake Merge Bounty}", an innovative skill-based merge puzzle experience exclusively available on ${platform:mobile devices}.

Core Gameplay Mechanics:
- Master the art of merging: strategically combine various bakery items to unlock increasingly sophisticated tiers and ascend the competitive global leaderboards.
- Emphasize the game's focus on pure skill and competitive balance, eliminating any pay-to-win mechanics or unfair advantages derived from in-app purchases.
- Explore a diverse range of bakery items and recipes, each with its unique properties and strategic value in the merge puzzle gameplay.

Polished Visual Design & User-Focused Experience:
- Immerse yourself in visually striking graphics optimized for accessibility and intuitive user navigation, ensuring a seamless and enjoyable gaming experience for all players.
- The user interface is designed with clarity in mind, providing essential information about item properties and merge requirements without cluttering the playing field.

Optional ${feature:blockchain-integrated reward program}:
- Dive into an optional, web-based reward program built on the Sui blockchain, offering a new dimension of engagement for dedicated players.
- Participation in this innovative system is entirely voluntary and independent of any in-app purchases, maintaining the game's core fairness and accessibility.
- Explore the unique mechanics of this blockchain integration, highlighting how it complements rather than dominates the core gameplay experience.
- Provide a clear explanation of how players can engage with this optional feature without intimidating or confusing those who prefer a purely mobile experience.

Preserve a professional yet engaging tone throughout the description, balancing clarity with the excitement of the game's unique features and competitive spirit. Ensure the text is structured for easy scanning and understanding by potential players, while maintaining a high level of polish and style consistent with the game's branding.
